text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396PX is part of the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switches - the foundation for a flexible, agile, and high-performing data center network infrastructure. It can operate in either NX-OS mode or as leaf node in an Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI).

graphic.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396PX is part of the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switches - the foundation for a flexible, agile, and high-performing data center network infrastructure. It can operate in either NX-OS mode or as leaf node in an Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI).

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396PX has 48 1/10G SFP+ ports and through an uplink module can add in 6 or 12 40G QSFP+ ports or 4 100GE ports. The switch is ideal as Top-of-Rack (TOR) or Mid-of-Row (MoR) switch and can be used for Nexus 2000 aggregation. Cisco provides 2 operating modes for the switch - NX-OS mode and ACI mode.

text.text: The Nexus 9396PX is a 2 RU non-blocking Layer 2/Layer 3 switch that offers 960Gbps bandwidth capacity. It features: 48 port fixed 10GbE SFP+ ports Uplink module slot supporting 6 or 12 port 40GbE QSFP+ ports or 4 100GE ports Low latency of 1-2 microsecond

graphic.text:
The Nexus 9396PX is a 2 RU non-blocking Layer 2/Layer 3 switch that offers 960Gbps bandwidth capacity. It features:
48 port fixed 10GbE SFP+ ports
Uplink module slot supporting 6 or 12 port 40GbE QSFP+ ports or 4 100GE ports
Low latency of 1-2 microsecond

text.text: The Nexus 9396PX supports the addition of an uplink module to the switch chassis with additional buffers per port. This module slot can be populated with either a: 4 port 100-Gbps CFP2 Module 6 port 40GbE QSFP+ Module, or 12 port 40GbE QSFP+ Module
